Advanced diagnostics, consolidated

/azure → Advanced diagnostics drawer, 1440×1000 · 2026-11-07

  • Opens on "Needs a look": 58 rows → 8. Only resources with a concern are listed; "All" is one click away. The Unhealthy / Waste / Security / Drift chips are gone because the Concern column already says why each row is there.
  • Always-On noise removed at the source: the scan flagged "Always-On disabled" on all 11 F1 apps, which F1 cannot turn on, so every app read "Drift". It is now skipped on F1/D1 plans; the 5 real "HTTP/2 disabled" findings remain.
  • Security block only when it has findings, and then opens by itself. No more closed "0 findings / Checks passed" row.
  • Heading "All resources" → "Resources", since it no longer lists everything by default.
